title: Premiere's timeline keys work the moment a recording opens
goal: Open a recording and press L to play, as every Premiere and Final Cut editor does, and the app picks the Line tool instead; I picks Measure, K the Lens, B does nothing on the timeline. The keys only mean play, mark and blade after a click on the timeline's own Select button, which nobody would guess. On a document with time, J, K, L, I, O, M and B should work from the moment it opens.
notes: Found by measure-the-video-editor-against-premiere-and-fi (2026-09-24); gap report docs/design/video-vs-premiere.md. Reproduced: /tmp five-minute walk, open a .mov, captionsWaitForThemselves, videoPause, key l: the Line tool lit in the tool bar (picture docs/design/video-vs-premiere/l-on-open-picks-line.jpg), transport stayed at 0:00. Keys s, c, q, w, ', ;, n, r pressed with the timeline focused were taken by nobody. The rule is written in Sources/PhotonzCore/TimelineKeys.swift: letters only mean the timeline's thing when timelineFocused; firstResponder after open is CanvasNSView (walk state). Related, not a duplicate: on-a-video-the-tool-bar-holds-the-video-tools-an (the tool bar set) and premiere-s-keys-work-on-the-timeline (done, built the focus rule). Needs a decision on where the keyboard lives on a video document only if the runner finds the answer is not obvious; the Premiere answer is: the timeline has the keys unless you are typing or drawing.
acceptance: A recording opened at Next defaults plays on L, stops on K and plays backwards on J with no click first
I and O set the In and Out, and B picks the Blade, straight after opening
Picture tools are still reachable on a video document by some means a Photoshop user would find (the tool bar, or their key once the canvas is clicked), and the walk shows which
A walk opens a recording and presses L as its very first act, and the transport reads playing
UX-PATTERNS (D18 or D4) says in one place which letters a document with time gives the timeline, and how the picture tools those letters used to pick are reached

log.note: digest 2026-09-24: no shared rule says which letters a document with time gives the timeline and which the picture tools keep. The premiere-keys task invented a focus ring to split them, this task undoes that, and on-a-video-the-tool-bar-holds-the-video-tools-an says folded tools keep their keys.
